call_scripts.critical_breach_alert: <Response><Say voice='Polly.Joanna-Neural'>Warning! Critical security breach detected by Sentinel Neural Engine. Attack type: {{ATTACK_TYPE}} targeting domain {{TARGET_DOMAIN}}. Originating IP address is {{SOURCE_IP}}. Automated countermeasures are active. Press 1 to acknowledge incident receipt and lock threat down, or press 2 to dispatch emergency failover.</Say><Gather action='/api/twilio/voice-response' numDigits='1' timeout='5'></Gather></Response>
call_scripts.escalation_failover_notice: <Response><Say voice='Polly.Joanna-Neural'>Alert! Priority 1 administrator did not respond. Incident {{INCIDENT_ID}} has been automatically escalated to Priority {{CURRENT_PRIORITY}} SOC Lead. Immediate action required.</Say></Response>
